2014 supports the newly compared check/attack/AC/casting subset only; conditions, exhaustion, general action and HP relations remain unsupported; the bounded single-cast action budget is separate.
Weapon profiles currently cover dagger and longbow in each PHB; WeaponReady explicitly supplies already-adjudicated hands, ammunition and permission.
CastingSource selects one concrete ability-granting entry per use. It does not infer spell access from class membership or a shared display name.
ArmorSpell describes a spell already successfully cast on a willing, unarmored target. It evaluates a later settled snapshot, not casting permission or resource consumption.
2014 untrained armor/shield is rejected pending interpretation of the mirror wording; no 2024 penalty or shield rule is substituted.
Pinned entry projections remain unreviewed. They preserve effective-knowledge IDs, evidence, review and decision records; they do not replace the review/publish workflow.
CastRequest represents a proposed single use; preflight refusal means it was not executed. Forced casts against invalid targets and their costs are not modeled.

FeatureAccess explicitly supplies already-acquired invocation ownership; character building is outside this chain. V/S/M readiness includes actual component access and any authorized substitution, not merely owning a focus.
CastBaseAC is the selected unarmored base formula without shield or other bonuses. Worn armor terminates the effect; its AC is not calculated by this timeline.
deferred: Full action implementations (hide, help, ready), rerolls and replacement choices
zero-HP death/stabilization, rests, concentration saves, general durations and state transitions outside the single-cast chain
condition effects outside the selected relations (equipment drops, aging/weight, charm harmful effects, frightened approach)
Remaining weapon profiles/properties, mastery, special AC formula selection, underwater/mounted combat and sense resolution
Other casting grants/choices, spell-slot-consuming execution, repeated casting/stacking, dispelling, counterspells, rests and general combat sequencing
input_contract: All scenario IDs must be unique across cases in a build; ordinary facts describe one settled evaluation snapshot; CastFollowup explicitly carries an ordered single-cast timeline.
Absent optional cause/condition/resistance means absent within this complete scenario, not unknown.

Ability scores, ranks, proficiency ownership, loadouts, DM choices, geometry/visibility and settled dice are external facts. SkillCheck, ToolCheck, WeaponUse and SpellSave derive Test/Attack; TestInput/AttackInput are explicit low-level inputs, never fallbacks for failed requests.
ReactionWindow is since the actor’s last turn start; Turn describes the current actor’s own turn.
Rule and claim annotations are assistant-authored, unreviewed; source coordinates do not imply approved rule identity.
DodgeActive means its duration has not ended; DodgeAttackerSeen is the defender’s sight of this attacker.
PassivePerception.modifier is the complete supplied perception modifier, including training and penalties.
Symbols are nonempty, at most 2048 characters, and exclude controls, double quotes and backslashes (Soufflé 2.5 proof serialization).
A build is one joint snapshot (and one initiative contest); use separate builds for independent encounters. Rank accepts integer levels/CR bands 1–30 only.
AvailableAction and DashExtra describe available options and their potential extra movement, not actions already executed. MovementCost does not maintain a movement budget.
Each requested test has exactly one request kind. Finesse requires an explicit str/dex choice; default does not choose the higher modifier.
SkillAbilityOverride records DM approval (the 2014 variant or the 2024 discretion); tool use records that this tool is applicable. Proficiencies are a complete snapshot, not inferred from names.
ArmorLoadout uses a versioned armor entry ID or unarmored, with explicit armor/shield training. Only one armor and one shield are modeled.
2014 Rank accepts player levels 1–20; 2024 retains integer level/CR bands 1–30. No cross-edition lookup or fallback is performed.
ArmorSpell elapsed_hours is whole elapsed hours; an ending event must remove the effect from later snapshots. It cannot be revived by removing armor. Dismissal in 2024 is unsupported.
Entry IDs and pinned body/field/effective-knowledge revisions must still match the catalog. Changes fail closed until the projection is re-inspected.

CastRequest is unique per run and actor. It names provider/grant/branch IDs in one edition, never spell names. CastResources, CastReadiness and Dexterity are mandatory; missing FeatureAccess means not owned.

CastFollowup steps are contiguous from 1, time is nondecreasing elapsed seconds since cast, turn is a nondecreasing own-turn index from 0. Each new normal turn supplies at most one action, execution is gated by can_act without consuming the unused budget. No bonus actions or Action Surge are modeled.
CastFollowup armored is a completed equipment-state observation, not a request to don/doff armor. can_act is explicit current permission, not inferred from an unmodeled condition list.

observe only advances state; spend_action records another main action; dismiss requests this version's explicit dismissal. Ended effects never restart. One actor cannot mix this timeline with ArmorSpell/ArmorLoadout snapshots or another cast run.
